title: Authorized peer DIO local-client stratum 4 samples are always rejected
description: Timing security review: DioTimeVerifier accepts peer-origin policy mapping Stratum.GNSS_GPSD to SourceClass.LOCAL_CLIENT, but emitted evidence omits source_subtype and source_subtype_verified. The tracker consequently rejects every such authorized sample as local-client-gpsd-not-verified. Either remove this unrepresentable origin mapping or issue immutable verifier-derived gpsd subtype evidence from the trusted peer-origin policy, with clear attestation semantics. Add peer-DIO local-client stratum 4 accept/reject, unauthorized signer, wrong stratum, and direct-provider distinction tests/vectors.
